profile.description: Baseline practical target for early concrete-family screening.

notes: security_proxy_bits and objective_score are screening scores, not cryptanalytic estimates
objective mode "bandwidth" caps excess security credit at 16 bits
proof strategies searched: full-surjective, support-covered, lossy-budget
primal distance models searched: guard-only, combined-proxy
combined-proxy rows are ranked with certification pressure penalty weight 0.25
sample_bits=0 means full-width public samples; smaller sample_bits applies bit-packing plus a conservative centered rounding-error penalty
view_coords=0 means all m0+m1 coordinates; smaller values model public-sample coordinate views that require support-covered or lossy-budget proof obligations
guard-only uses the proven guard-block distance and requires m0>=n; combined-proxy prices distance from the viewed combined matrix and requires a later combined-distance certificate
combined_certification_pressure is a cheap proxy for how much rank/distance work the later combined certificate must do; lower is easier to certify
full-surjective and support-covered are exact-sample proof strategies; lossy-budget is the only route that accepts nonzero sample_bits in this engine
hard filters encode current proof-side constraints such as q > n + m0 + m1 and m0 >= n
top candidates require exact finite-field and lattice/coding follow-up before any security claim
